slides.texte_overlay:
where our strangest
superstitions come from

an umbrella opened indoors

victorian umbrellas had springs
that could break things.

friday the 13th

the fear grew in the
20th century.

a horseshoe over the door

iron was believed to keep
fairies away.

crossing your fingers

an old sign to ask
for protection.

the number 4 in east asia

it sounds like the word
for death.

a four-leaf clover

about one in 10,000
clovers has one.
which one do you believe in?
